# graviteeam_extension_grant (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Extension Grant (e.g. JWT Bearer)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_extension_grant" "example" {
  domain_id     = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name          = "JWT Bearer Grant"
  type          = "jwtbearer-am-extension-grant"
  grant_type    = "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer"
  configuration = jsonencode({
    publicKey = "ssh-rsa AAAA..."
  })
  create_user = false
  user_exists = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String) JSON configuration for the extension grant plugin
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this extension grant belongs to
- `grant_type` (String) The OAuth 2.0 grant type URI (e.g. urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer)
- `name` (String) The name of the extension grant
- `type` (String) The plugin type (e.g. jwtbearer-am-extension-grant)

### Optional

- `create_user` (Boolean) Create user if not found
- `identity_provider` (String) The identity provider ID to use for user resolution
- `user_exists` (Boolean) Check if user exists

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the extension grant
